concern_results.conclusion: All three version fields (package.json, lockfile root, lockfile packages[""]) move 0.10.0 -> 0.11.0 consistently; no other package fields touched. Matches stated intent.
No scripts, dependencies, permissions, workflows, or credentials changed. The two new evidence files contain only a public commit SHA and ref name; no publish or tag action is present.
Version skew is the only realistic failure path and it is closed by the coordinated three-field edit. No runtime, concurrency, or recovery surface is touched.
Test pass claims are not verifiable from the bounded packet, but the diff contains no executable change that any test could regress, so the gap is not material.
Pure metadata bump; no API, CLI, asset, or dependency-range change. No added abstraction or complexity.
Non-publishing change; rollback is a plain revert of these commits. No irreversible action included.
Version is the observable release identifier and is coherent across metadata. The two byte-identical attestation files add no diagnostic value but pose no operational risk.
